prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity dark desktop portfolio landing-page direction comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakably non-generic responsive website viewport for COLTON SPURGIN as a night reference-setting page drawn by a ruling engine. A narrow living index keys a candid record while a vast black annotation margin keeps the page severe and quiet.
Scene/backdrop: no scene; flat front-facing dark website interface like an open reference edition on a black reading table
Subject: a candid portfolio for an Air Force NCO, lead software developer intern, research assistant, and UWF senior specializing in AI graduating December 2026, who wants to build useful ambitious software and pursue a master’s degree
Style/medium: high-fidelity typographic web UI, black book cloth, one small bone paper block, iron-black serif text, vermilion keys and one-device-pixel rules; cerebral but not precious
Composition/framing: eighty percent of the viewport is matte black annotation margin. A compact bone paper block sits slightly right of center and contains two narrow readable columns under the title COLTON SPURGIN. A fixed vertical vermilion centre rail splits the columns with keys 01 WORK, 02 EXPERIENCE, 03 RESEARCH, 04 ABOUT, 05 CONTACT. In the black margin, a large bone headline reads “THE WORK IS THE ARGUMENT.” and sparse ruled notes identify AIR FORCE NCO, LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN, RESEARCH ASSISTANT, AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026. The paper block begins a terse selected-work index: BORK, VELLM, TSP BENCHMARKS, HOME LAB. Make the red moving rail the only dynamic focal element; all controls appear as printed marks, detents, brackets, and strike-throughs with zero radius.
Color palette: black cloth #090909, bone #d8cebb, rubric vermilion #b9362b
Materials/textures: black book cloth, unbleached paper, iron ink, hairline ruling, small metal detents
Text (verbatim): “COLTON SPURGIN”; “THE WORK IS THE ARGUMENT.”; “01 WORK”; “02 EXPERIENCE”; “03 RESEARCH”; “04 ABOUT”; “05 CONTACT”; “AIR FORCE NCO”; “LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN”; “RESEARCH ASSISTANT”; “AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026”; “SELECTED WORK”; “BORK”; “VELLM”; “TSP BENCHMARKS”; “HOME LAB”; “OPEN THE RECORD”
Constraints: functional dark desktop website, not a book photograph or poster; wide margin and compact two-column block must be obvious; exact clear navigation; no portrait, no logo, no invented metrics, employers, awards, testimonials, or project claims
Avoid: generic hero plus card grid, bento grid, beige full-page editorial portfolio, cyberpunk neon, terminal UI, cockpit, military insignia, rounded cards, gradients, glassmorphism, 3D device mockup, browser chrome, illegible pseudo-text, watermark
